landing.eyebrow: Telegram music, live on the web
landing.title: Turn your Telegram music channel into a real radio.
landing.lead: Everyone hears the same song at the same moment — on the web, in the app, and live inside Telegram. With synchronized lyrics, ads and community votes.
landing.proof.sync: One shared timeline for every listener
landing.demo.title: Your station
landing.stations.sub: Pick a station — each one has its own page and link.
landing.stations.none: No station is on air yet. Check back soon.
landing.features.title: Everything a radio needs
landing.f.sync.d: One shared timeline: nobody starts a song from the beginning. Join any time and hear what everyone hears.
landing.f.telegram.d: The same station plays in your channel's live stream, with the title, artist and ad on the video.
landing.f.lyrics.d: Lyrics highlighted line by line, aligned automatically — Persian and English.
landing.f.data.d: A light stream for slow connections; the player switches by itself when the network struggles.
landing.f.ads.d: Audio ads between songs, banners and sponsor buttons. Advertisers self-serve; you approve.
landing.f.vote.d: Tag votes let the audience choose the next mood, live.
landing.f.pwa.d: Add it to your phone's home screen. Lock-screen controls included.
landing.f.lang.d: A full right-to-left interface, and more languages are one JSON file away.
landing.how.title: How it works
landing.how.1.d: Log in once and add your music channel. New songs are picked up automatically.
landing.how.2.d: Choose hashtags and rules; the station plays non-stop, with ads and votes if you want them.
landing.how.3.d: Every station gets its own page. Listeners hear it on the web or live in Telegram.
landing.adv.title: For advertisers
landing.adv.desc: Create a campaign with audio, an image and a link, pick a station and dates, and see plays and clicks.
landing.op.title: For channel owners
landing.op.desc: Manage stations, rules, lyrics, ads and the Telegram live stream from one panel.
landing.final.title: The music is playing. Join in.
landing.stations.title: Stations
player.streamError: The stream stopped. Tap play to reconnect.
vote.title: What should we play next?
vote.timeLeft: {time} left, then back to the usual mix
ads.title: Audio ads
ads.help: Upload an audio file (MP3 recommended, max 10 MB) and optionally an image and a link. Ads play between tracks; set how often in "Tag vote & ad frequency". Listeners see the image and a button while the ad plays.
ads.name: Name
sponsors.title: Sponsors
sponsors.help: A sponsor is a banner with a button in the player. Give it a name, a link and optionally a logo and a date window.
sponsors.name: Name
engagement.title: Tag vote & ad frequency
engagement.adsHelp: How often an ad is played between tracks on this station.
engagement.adsEvery: Play an ad after every N tracks (0 = off)
engagement.adsOn: An ad plays after every {n} tracks.
engagement.voteHelp: Every so often listeners are offered a few tags. The tag with the most votes plays for a while, then the radio returns to its normal selection.
engagement.allowlistHelp: Comma separated. Empty = any tag that has at least 2 playable tracks.
engagement.noneActive: No vote is running right now.
liveTarget.help: In Telegram open the channel > Start live stream > "Stream with..." and copy the Server URL and Stream key here. Works like OBS and needs no admin rights for our account. You can also paste one full link that ends with the key.
liveTarget.keyOptional: empty if the link already contains the key
platform.title: Billing & access
platform.billingHelp: While billing is off everything is free and unlimited: no prices, no credit, nothing is blocked for money. Turn it on later and the prices below start to apply; nothing else needs to change.
platform.billingEnabled: Enable billing (advertisers pay from their credit)
platform.selfSignup: Anyone can sign up for an account
platform.approval: Campaigns must be approved by me before they play
accounts.title: Customer accounts
accounts.confirmSuspend: Suspend "{name}"? Their campaigns stop airing and they are signed out.
review.title: Campaign review
portal.title: Advertiser portal
portal.tagline: Reach listeners with audio ads, or manage your own radio station.
portal.freeNote: Free during launch: no charges, no limits on price.
portal.paidNote: Ads are pay-per-use: {play} per play and {click} per click ({currency}), taken from your credit.
portal.campaignHelp: Upload your audio (MP3 recommended), optionally an image and a link, then submit it for review. It plays between tracks once approved.
portal.howToTopUp: To add credit, contact the operator; the balance updates as soon as they confirm your payment.
portal.noStations: You don't have a station yet. Ask the operator to assign one to your account.
account.title: Account & password
account.forced: You signed in with the default password. Choose a new one to continue; nothing else works until you do.
account.rules: At least 8 characters, not "admin", different from the current one. Changing it signs out every other session.
account.mismatch: The two new passwords do not match
account.forgotHelp: Run this on the server (it needs DATABASE_URL). Without a password argument it prints a random one and asks you to change it at the next login.
engagement.transportHelp: Choose what the public player uses for this station. The HTTP stream URL keeps working for other apps either way.
engagement.transportHttpNote: Works everywhere (phones, background play, lock-screen controls, proxies/CDN).
engagement.transportWsNote: Binary frames over WebSocket into the browser's Media Source. Browsers that cannot do it (e.g. iPhone) fall back to HTTP automatically. Only the leader instance can serve it.
announce.title: Live announcements
announce.help: Shown instantly on every listener's screen, then removed automatically.
